abstract: Cervical teratomas are rarely encountered in adults. We report herein the case of a 21-year-old woman who was admitted to our hospital for surgical treatment of a neck tumor, 7.5 x 4.5 x 2.7 cm in size, located in the left lower pole of the thyroid. Ultrasonography (US) and computed tomography (CT) revealed a multicystic tumor. The levels of carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA), carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA19-9), and squamous cell carcinoma-related antigen (SCC) in the cystic fluid were extremely elevated in contrast to the normal levels found in the serum. The tumor was completely excised and histological examination revealed it to be composed of elements derived from the three germ layers, confirming a diagnosis of benign cystic teratoma.
abstract_ja: 成人の頸部奇形腫はまれである。今回、21歳女性が甲状腺左下極に位置する7.5×4.5×2.7cmの頸部腫瘍の外科的治療目的で当院に入院した。超音波検査およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で多嚢胞性腫瘍が認められた。嚢胞液中の癌胎児性抗原(CEA)、CA19-9、扁平上皮癌関連抗原(SCC)は、血清中の正常値とは対照的に著しく上昇していた。腫瘍は完全切除され、組織学的検査で三胚葉由来の成分から構成されていることが判明し、良性嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。
